decisions.reason: VRTC and VBACKUP pin handling does not alter the AXP2101 exposed-pad heat-transfer requirement.
Exposing VBACKUP and leaving VRTC unconnected does not change the charge-status display or external charge-LED interface.
The RTC auxiliary-pin decision does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, compensation, or load coverage.
VRTC and VBACKUP are distinct from the PWRON signal and do not change the panel-mounted power-button interface.
The optional RTC backup pad does not affect the MT3608 enable control, 5V loads, or boost-rail behavior.
An optional future RTC backup source does not modify the main battery's overcharge, overdischarge, or short-circuit protection requirements.
The possible capacitor on VBACKUP serves RTC retention and does not change the ESP32 supply-decoupling capacitors or their placement.
The RTC backup-power pad does not alter the J_BAT NTC connection or AXP2101 battery thermal monitoring.
VBACKUP powers only RTC retention when the main battery is absent and does not change the system power source, required rails, load coverage, or charging behavior.
The VRTC/VBACKUP decision does not change which system rails are monitored or the INA3221 monitoring arrangement.
The small VBACKUP test pad is unrelated to the minimum-width routing requirement for the high-current VBUS, +5V, and BAT- nets.
Mentioning main-battery removal and an optional separate RTC backup source does not change the main battery connector family, pin count, pin functions, or unresolved pin order.
